requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues including incorrect hex handling and incomplete RLP encoding/decoding logic. Tests fail with ValueError for non-hexadecimal numbers in fromhex() and various encoding mismatches.
requirement.contract: Implement a complete and correct RLP encoding/decoding system that properly handles hex strings, integers, and lists according to the RLP specification. The rlp_encode function must correctly encode data types and handle hex strings with proper validation. The rlp_decode function must correctly decode RLP-encoded data back to original types.

requirement.description: The keccak hashing implementation fails on systems where hashlib doesn't support keccak_256. Tests fail with AttributeError: module 'hashlib' has no attribute 'keccak_256'.
requirement.contract: Ensure the keccak function properly handles different Python versions and available libraries. When hashlib.keccak_256 is not available, fall back to pysha3 library or other compatible implementation.

requirement.description: The address creation logic fails because it depends on an external 'rlp' package that is not installed in the environment. Tests fail with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rlp'.
requirement.contract: Modify the get_created_address function to use the internal RLP encoding implementation instead of requiring an external 'rlp' package. Ensure the implementation properly encodes the sender and nonce using RLP and computes the correct keccak-256 hash.

requirement.description: Missing proper hex string validation and handling in the rlp_encode function. When hex strings are passed, they are not properly validated or converted.
requirement.contract: Update the rlp_encode function to properly validate and process hex strings when str_mode='hex' is specified. Hex strings should be validated for proper hexadecimal format and converted to bytes appropriately.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode function doesn't correctly handle all data types and edge cases. Some test cases fail because the implementation produces incorrect RLP encodings.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to correctly handle all data types (strings, integers, lists) and produce valid RLP encodings according to the specification. Ensure proper handling of short vs long form encodings.
